speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I understand you are experiencing vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain while pregnant. To help me assess your condition safely, can you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when the bleeding started? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Serum Beta-HCG, and Urine Toxicology.

text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Vaginal bleeding. I also have Severe abdominal pain, History of contractions that stopped, Previous cesarean delivery.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: One previous childbirth via cesarean section. No other significant past medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, occasional alcohol consumption. Works as an elementary school teacher.
